0.original: <hex:024804F201FC03><hex:024904F201FD03> Quest Sync<hex:0249020103><hex:0248020103><hex:02100103>Despite appearances, Alkmene has a lot on her mind.

24.original: Survey flower beds and obtain aetherial masses.

48.original: Awww! Awen't you just <hex:021A020203>adowable<hex:021A020103>? Yes, yes you are!

53.original: Hee hee! That's what I love about familiars─so whimsical! I have a task that is perfectly suited to one such as yourself.

54.original: Hee hee! My apologies, dear─your whimsically diminutive stature misled me. Fortunately, I have a task perfectly suited to an oh-so-grown-up familiar such as yourself.

55.original: I would like you to inspect the flower beds north of here. I suspect they will have accumulated some aetherial masses.

56.original: Should you find any, please bring them to me. Do look carefully, now─if I needed someone to wander off with the task half-finished, I would have asked one of the other researchers.

57.original: Even if you see no aetherial masses at first glance, you must scrutinize the flower beds to make sure. I'm certain you can do it!

58.original: Though you examine the flower bed closely, there are no aetherial masses to be found.

59.original: An aetherial mass floats over the flower bed, ripe for the picking. Probably.

60.original: Did you scrutinize every corner of the beds?

61.original: As I suspected─masses of earthen aspect.

62.original: The gardens of the Twelve Wonders reflect the balance of dynamic and stagnant aether of all six aspects. An excess of activity in a single aspect leads to this type of agglomeration.

63.original: 'Tis these flowers' way of bearing fruit, so to speak.

64.original: Beautiful as that may sound, aetherial masses indicate that we must adjust the aetherial balance in Elpis to maintain an ideal environment.

65.original: There's naught for you to worry your dear little head about, of course. Such magic is as simple as breathing for us. Run along, now!
